retention.note: Recovery/lifecycle values remain unconfirmed. Preserve source/policy/manifest/check history and the last approved digest; read-only metadata collection never authorizes cleanup, rollout or restore. Owner must register retention and revocation rechecks before any such action.

rollbackRetention.note: After a restore, old evidence can never authorize a new SHA; rollback targets the same digest and keeps the last approved artifact; a credential rotation or revocation forces re-verification because a backup cannot restore revoked capabilities.
